# ferriskey_resource_owners (Resource)

Manages which client owns each protected resource of a FerrisKey realm (singleton per realm). A protected resource is identified by its URI, which must already be listed in the realm's `allowed_resources` setting; its owner is a confidential, admin-registered client of the same realm. The API replaces the whole list on every write, so this resource is **authoritative** for the realm: owners not listed in `owners` are removed, and destroying the resource clears all owners.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ferriskey_resource_owners" "main" {
  realm = "acme"

  owners = [
    {
      uri       = "https://mcp.example.com"
      client_id = ferriskey_client.mcp.client_uuid
    },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `owners` (Attributes Set) Resource ownerships. Each `uri` can appear only once. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--owners))
- `realm` (String) Realm whose resource owners are managed. Changing it forces a new resource.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Resource identifier (equal to `realm`).

<a id="nestedatt--owners"></a>
### Nested Schema for `owners`

Required:

- `client_id` (String) UUID of the owning client (`client_uuid` of `ferriskey_client`). Must be confidential and registered by an admin.
- `uri` (String) URI of the protected resource; must be one of the realm's `allowed_resources`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import ferriskey_resource_owners.main acme
```
